why:
Twelve clips failed Gemini's look-real test. Three faults explain nearly all of it, and all three were authored, not bad luck:
  1. Telling Veo 'nothing moves' produces a still with a digital zoom. Every re-render now NAMES a small human motion to render — a blink, a breath, a head turn.
  2. Walking legs slide. Nobody walks in frame any more, or the feet are out of frame.
  3. Thin held objects vanish or morph. Pens and dip rods are gone; a phone is the only thing anyone holds.
One extra fix: C02's canopy carried a blue-and-red livery band, which the no-other-company's-mark rule forbids.
man: An Indian man in his mid-fifties, greying hair, trimmed moustache, sturdy build, plain cream full-sleeve shirt with the sleeves rolled to the forearm, dark navy trousers, a steel wristwatch. Warm, tired, dignified.

shots.fault: he slid instead of walking and merged with the car pillar
shots.prompt: Locked-off wide vertical shot of a small Indian fuel station at night, seen from across the forecourt. Plain white canopy with plain white lighting and NO coloured band of any kind, two plain white dispensers, a low office block with dark glass behind. Warm light pools on wet concrete. A car is ALREADY PARKED at the far dispenser, engine idling, headlights on, thin exhaust drifting up through the beam. NOBODY WALKS ANYWHERE IN FRAME. The only movement is the drifting exhaust, one moth circling a canopy lamp, and the shimmer of light on the wet ground. The camera does not move at all.

shots.fault: a still image with a digital zoom; nobody blinked or breathed
shots.prompt: Vertical medium shot, late afternoon on an Indian fuel station forecourt. In the foreground right, an Indian man in his mid-fifties with greying hair and a trimmed moustache, plain cream full-sleeve shirt with sleeves rolled, stands with his hands in his trouser pockets, framed from the chest up. HE IS ALIVE AND MOVING: his chest rises and falls as he breathes, he blinks twice, his jaw tightens, and near the end he slowly turns his head to look off to the left and lets out a breath. Behind him, well out of focus, another man in a plain shirt gestures with one arm and lowers it. Plain white canopy overhead with NO coloured stripe or band. Camera completely static, no zoom, no push. Warm low sun, 35mm, shallow focus.

Vertical medium shot on a fuel station forecourt in soft morning light. An Indian man in his mid-fifties, greying hair, trimmed moustache, plain cream full-sleeve shirt with sleeves rolled, stands beside a plain white dispenser holding a smartphone in both hands at chest height. He reads it, his eyebrows lift slightly, he blinks, then lifts his chin and breathes out with relief. His feet are OUT OF FRAME. The phone screen is bright and completely defocused with no readable content. Camera static. Shallow depth of field, 35mm.

shots.fault: the camera pan revealed malformed background people
shots.prompt: Vertical medium close shot inside a modern Indian office, camera LOCKED OFF with no pan and no movement. Two people in their late twenties in plain shirts sit at a desk in the foreground wearing slim headsets, sharply in focus. The one on the left listens, nods, and types; the one on the right turns her head, says something, and smiles. Behind them the rest of the floor is thrown COMPLETELY out of focus into soft bokeh so no other person is ever resolved. Warm daylight from a window on the left, a plant at the edge of frame, bare walls. Monitors face away, no readable screen content.

Vertical medium close shot of two Indian colleagues side by side at a desk, a man in his thirties and a woman in her late twenties, both looking at a monitor just off frame. He leans in, lifts a hand and points, then sits back; she nods twice, blinks, and half-smiles. Their hands stay open and empty, nobody holds a pen or any small object. Warm window light from the left, deep soft bokeh behind them. The monitor's glow falls on their faces; the screen itself is never seen. Camera static, 35mm.

Vertical close shot of a young Indian engineer in his mid-twenties in a plain dark t-shirt, seated at a desk, face lit by a monitor that faces away from camera. He is reading; he blinks, narrows his eyes slightly, leans in a few centimetres, then sits back and exhales. His hands rest flat on the desk and hold nothing. Warm office darkness around him, a plain mug on the desk. Nothing on any screen is visible or readable. Camera static, shallow focus, 35mm.

shots.fault: the phone screen was a morphing mess and a notice board carried readable text
shots.prompt: Vertical medium close shot of an Indian man in his mid-fifties in a cream full-sleeve shirt, standing at a counter in a small fuel station office, holding a smartphone flat above a sheet of plain white paper. THE PHONE SCREEN IS COMPLETELY BLACK AND SWITCHED OFF throughout. He steadies the phone with both hands, his thumb presses once, he blinks and gives a small nod. The paper is blank white with no writing or printing. THE WALL BEHIND HIM IS BARE PAINTED PLASTER with no notice, poster, board, sign or paper of any kind on it. Warm side light from a window, dust in the beam. Camera static.

shots.fault: his feet slid and the ground texture crawled
shots.prompt: Wide vertical establishing shot of a clean, calm, empty Indian fuel station forecourt at dawn. Plain white canopy and plain white dispensers with no branding. An Indian man in his mid-fifties in a cream full-sleeve shirt and dark navy trousers is ALREADY STANDING STILL in the lower third, hands loose at his sides, looking across at his own pump. HE DOES NOT WALK. He breathes, his shoulders settle, and he turns his head slowly to look along the canopy. Thin morning mist drifts across the forecourt behind him and a bird crosses the sky. Camera completely static, no push. 35mm.

Vertical chest-up shot of an Indian man in his mid-fifties, greying hair and trimmed moustache, cream full-sleeve shirt, standing under a fuel station canopy in morning light holding a smartphone up in front of him in one hand. He reads it, his eyes move across the screen, he blinks, his shoulders drop, and he nods once and almost smiles. The phone screen is bright and entirely defocused. Camera static. Sharp on his face, soft canopy behind, 35mm.

shots.fault: his grip on the thin dip rod was wrong and his smile was too smooth
shots.prompt: Vertical waist-up shot of an Indian man in his mid-fifties in a cream full-sleeve shirt with sleeves rolled, standing on a fuel station forecourt in morning light, holding ONLY a smartphone in one hand at chest height. HE HOLDS NOTHING ELSE — no rod, no pen, no paper. He glances down at the phone, then up and off to the left, and gives a short satisfied nod; he blinks and breathes. His other hand rests on his hip. The phone screen is defocused. Camera static, sharp on him, background soft, 35mm.

Vertical waist-up shot of an Indian man in his mid-fifties, greying hair, trimmed moustache, cream full-sleeve shirt with sleeves rolled, standing squarely on his own fuel station forecourt in evening light, hands relaxed at his sides, eyes just off the lens. He breathes in, his chest settles, he blinks slowly and his jaw sets — calm and certain. A light breeze moves his collar and his hair. Camera static. Plain white canopy soft behind him with no branding, 35mm.

shots.fault: his feet slid across the ground
shots.prompt: Wide vertical shot of an Indian fuel station forecourt at golden hour, canopy lights just coming on against a warm sky. The upper third of the frame is clean open sky with nothing in it. An Indian man in his mid-fifties in a cream full-sleeve shirt stands STILL and upright near the island in the lower third, looking out towards the road. NOBODY WALKS IN FRAME. The movement is the light changing as the canopy lamps warm up, a slow drift of cloud, and his shirt moving in the breeze. Camera completely static. Plain white canopy with no branding, 35mm.
